configuracoes.erro.destaques_n: The number of highlights must be a whole number from 1 to 100. Nothing was saved.
configuracoes.fontes.explicacao: One switch per source. A source that is off does not run and shows as off in source health.
configuracoes.funcoes.explicacao: Each feature has its own switch. When off, it stops acting; whatever was already saved stays.
configuracoes.funcao.descoberta_cc_ligad: When off, discovery does not run. Suggestions already made stay on screen.
configuracoes.funcao.paginas_ligadas.aju: When off, no page is checked.
configuracoes.funcao.enriquecimento_liga: When off, job detail pages are not fetched, and the sitemap sources bring no new jobs.
configuracoes.funcao.destaques_ligados.a: When off, the tab goes away and the panel opens on All.
configuracoes.funcao.conversao_moeda_lig: When off, no exchange rate is requested; a job in another currency keeps only its original amount and the salary rule does not hide it. Jobs in reais stay as they are.
configuracoes.funcao.regras_ocultar_liga: When off, nothing is hidden by rule. Hiding by hand still works.
configuracoes.funcoes.destaques_n.ajuda: How many jobs the Highlights tab shows, from 1 to 100.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.explicacao: With background on, joBot starts by itself with your user session and looks for jobs while you do something else.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.nao_linux: Background only works on Linux. On this machine it stays off.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.ligar.ajuda: Creates the systemd user service. Turning it off removes the service.
configuracoes.segundo_plano.recusa: Could not change the background setting.
configuracoes.erro.segundo_plano_arquivo: I could not write the service files. It may be a permission or disk space problem (details in the log).
configuracoes.aparencia.explicacao: Theme, language and text size apply to the whole panel and are kept on this computer.
configuracoes.aparencia.ajuda_pais: Used for searches without a city and to pick the currency. The panel language is chosen separately.
configuracoes.privacidade.onde: Everything stays on this computer, in the folder:
configuracoes.privacidade.telemetria: joBot has no account and no ads: no telemetry and none of your data is sent. It only makes network requests in these cases: to the public job sources you leave on (they all come on), including each job's page; to the Central Bank of Brazil, to get the exchange rates of the currencies in the jobs and show salaries in the display currency you choose, with currency conversion on (it comes on); to Common Crawl, once a week, to discover new companies, and then to those companies' job boards, to check them (it comes on); to the pages you ask it to follow (it comes on, but with no pages on the list there is no request); to the sites with login you turn on (they come off), through the browser, with your account; to Playwright's servers, to download the browser, only when you press "Download" in Tools; to 2Captcha, only when you test the key in Settings, Services, or, while browsing with login, with the key saved and the switch on (comes off); to a company's website, only when you paste an address, test it or accept a suggestion; to the internet through git and uv, to download the new joBot version, only when you ask to update (the jobot atualizar command). With the version notice below on, it also asks GitHub (it comes on; you can turn it off). Whoever receives a request sees your computer's IP address, as with any internet request.
configuracoes.privacidade.disco: Your data sits in ordinary files. We recommend turning on disk encryption on your computer, so nobody can read the folder above if the device is lost.
configuracoes.privacidade.aviso_versao: Tell me when a new version is out
configuracoes.privacidade.aviso_versao.a: It comes on: once a day joBot asks GitHub for the latest version. The request carries no search or personal data, only your IP, like any request on the internet. When off, this notice makes no request.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.frase: Solves CAPTCHAs for you when browsing with a login, which arrives in a future version.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.usar.ajud: Off, joBot stops and waits for you to solve it, as always.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.chave.aju: The key stays in the system password vault and never comes back to the screen. Leave it empty to keep the saved key.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.no_arquiv: This computer has no password vault available. The key was kept in a file that only your user can read, in the data folder.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.log: It only applies to browsing with a login, which does not exist yet. Public sources never use it.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.ter: Solving CAPTCHAs may go against some sites' terms, and your account there may be restricted.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.cus: Each solve costs money from your 2Captcha account. joBot stops after {teto} per day.
configuracoes.servicos.captcha.aviso.dad: Only the page address, the challenge's public code and the browser's user agent go to 2Captcha. No personal data.
configuracoes.servicos.erro.formato: The key must have 16 to 64 letters and numbers, with no spaces. Nothing was saved.
configuracoes.servicos.erro.cofre: I could not store or delete the key. The details are in jobot.log.
configuracoes.servicos.erro.sem_chave: Type a key or save one before testing.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.explicacao: Reading sites with login may go against their terms, and your account may be restricted. You decide site by site. joBot never types your password and only reads: you sign in to the site and it reads the jobs from that session, only on the sites you turn on here.
No browser found. Install Google Chrome or download the browser in Tools.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.horarios.a: 1 to 4 times in the HH:MM format, separated by commas, at least 4 hours apart. Example: 09:00, 18:00.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.horarios.f: Use the HH:MM format, separating the times with commas (for example 09:00, 18:00).
configuracoes.sites_com_login.horarios.p: Leave at least 4 hours between one time and the next.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.em_andamen: A reading is in progress; try again when it finishes.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.agua: Sign in to the site and close the window when you are done. joBot then checks the sign-in by itself (the window closes after {minutos} minutes if left open).
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.pron: Signed in. joBot can now read this site.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.nao_: Could not confirm the sign-in. Try again and sign in before closing the window.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.temp: The window stayed open for {minutos} minutes without a sign-in and was closed. Try again.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.sem_: Could not find the computer's screen to open the browser. Try again with the desktop session open.
No browser found. Install Google Chrome or download the browser in Settings, Tools, and try again.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.em_u: joBot's browser is already open. Close it and try again.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.login.erro: Something went wrong opening the browser. The details are in jobot.log.
configuracoes.sites_com_login.esquecer.p: Delete the logins for all sites?
configuracoes.sites_com_login.esquecer.e: joBot deletes its browser folder, with the sessions of every site. Your jobs stay. To read these sites again, sign in again.
Could not delete the logins. The details are in jobot.log.
configuracoes.ferramentas.explicacao: Programs joBot downloads separately, only when you ask. Today it is only the browser for sites with login.
configuracoes.ferramentas.navegador.tama: About 210 MB to download, from Playwright's servers, and about 420 MB on disk.
configuracoes.ferramentas.estado.chrome: joBot uses this computer's Google Chrome. Nothing to download, and joBot does not touch it.
configuracoes.ferramentas.dica_baixando: It can take a few minutes; joBot keeps working.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.pronto: Browser downloaded. Sites with login can use it now.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.removido: Browser removed. To use sites with login again, download it again.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.continua: Another program on this computer uses the same copy of the browser: it stays on disk, and joBot keeps using it.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.em_uso: A site with login is open right now. Wait for the reading or the login to finish and try again.
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.falhou_b: Could not download the browser. Check your internet connection and free disk space and try again. The details are in joBot's log (jobot.log).
configuracoes.ferramentas.aviso.falhou_r: Could not remove the browser. Try again. The details are in joBot's log (jobot.log).
configuracoes.contas.explicacao: See whether joBot is still signed in to each site, and sign in again when needed.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.sem_rede: No internet, or the site did not answer.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.desafio: The site asked for an anti-robot check.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.sem_tela: No screen to open the browser.
configuracoes.contas.motivo.erro: Something went wrong. Details are in the log.
configuracoes.contas.ocupado: Something is already using the browser; try again in a moment.
configuracoes.contas.conferir_espera: Checked a moment ago. You can check again in a few minutes.
